structure: Part 16, Manage notifications. Read manage-notifications.fit.spec.js in full and opened and mined all 7 traces it produced, every action of each: (A) view › submitted with action required (53 actions); (B) view › submitted, past and draft (51); (C) amend › confirm, change an answer, save and return, then resubmit (108); (D) amend › cancel an amendment from the amend review (35); (E) amend and copy guards (25); (F) copy as new (33); (G) delete a notification (50). Refs below name the trace by its zip stem. Pages reached, in journey order: the Live animals dashboard (/live-animals, View link only); the notification view page /review-notification?reference=<ref> in four states (submitted with action required, submitted, past, draft), each with a page header (reference as h1, status tag, an MoJ button menu 'Actions', a date line), an 'Import reference numbers' section and five numbered read-only (or, for a draft, editable) answer sections; the amend confirmation page /notifications/amend; the amend review (/review-notification in amend state, headed 'Review your notification', then 'Review before re-submitting' once an answer has changed) with an Amend status bar, a Cancel amend link-button and a cancel-amend modal; question pages opened in amend (origin-of-the-import, arrival-details) with Save and return / Save and continue / Save and return to overview; the declaration; the notification-submitted page; /notifications/cancel-amend (GET, redirects); /notifications/copy-as-new (GET, redirects to the notification hub with a new draft); the delete confirmation page /notifications/delete and the dashboard success banner. Conditional: Amend appears in the Actions menu only for submitted notifications; Change links appear only for draft and amend states; the warning and Continue button only for action-required; the error summary only for a draft with incomplete sections. The network log shows only the prototype's own server-rendered GET/POST routes, no outbound data calls. Make template is linked from the menu but never followed in this part.

claims.statement: Each notification row on the Live animals dashboard has a 'View' link that opens the notification's view page at /review-notification?reference=<reference>.
claims.note: href seen: /design-release-2.1/review-notification?reference=GBN-AG-26-7K8M2P

claims.statement: The notification view page's h1 is the notification reference number, not a descriptive heading.
The view page's browser title is the service name only, with no page-specific prefix.
claims.note: Every other page in this part carries a page-specific title prefix; the view page does not.

claims.statement: Beside the reference the view page shows a GOV.UK tag with the notification's status: 'Submitted', 'Past' or 'Draft'.
The status tag carries a status-specific modifier class: submitted for Submitted, submission-complete for Past, and template for Draft.
claims.note: The Draft tag uses the --template modifier, which looks like a prototype slip; the reconciler should not read it as a template state. A govuk-tag colour modifier would replace the custom app-dr2-review-status__tag classes.

claims.statement: A submitted or past notification's view page shows the date it was submitted under the header, labelled 'Date submitted:' with a long-form date.
A draft notification's view page shows 'Date created:' with a long-form date in place of the submitted date.
The view page header has an 'Actions' button that opens a menu of actions for the notification.
The Actions menu is the Ministry of Justice button menu component (moj-button-menu), whose items are links styled as buttons.
claims.note: The MoJ button menu needs JavaScript to collapse into a toggle; without JavaScript MoJ renders the items as a row of buttons.

claims.statement: For a submitted notification the Actions menu lists, in order, 'Amend', 'Make template', 'Copy as new' and 'Delete'.
claims.quote: Amend / Make template / Copy as new / Delete

claims.statement: The Actions menu items link to /notifications/amend, /notifications/make-template, /notifications/copy-as-new and /notifications/delete, each with ?reference=<reference>.
A past notification's Actions menu has no Amend: it offers only 'Make template', 'Copy as new' and 'Delete'.
A draft notification's Actions menu has no Amend: it offers only 'Make template', 'Copy as new' and 'Delete'.
A submitted notification that needs action shows a GOV.UK warning text in its header saying what the trader must do.
claims.quote: You need to upload a health certificate

claims.statement: The action-required warning appears only on a notification that needs action: the plain submitted notification has no header warning.
claims.quote:
GBN-AG-26-7K8M2U
Submitted
Actions

Date submitted: 25 November 2026

claims.statement: The action-required state still shows the status tag 'Submitted'; the need for action is carried by the warning and a page-level modifier class, not by the tag.
The view page has an 'Import reference numbers' section, headed by an h2.
The Import reference numbers section opens with a warning text telling the trader to use the right reference and code on the customs declaration.
claims.quote: You must use the correct reference and code on the customs declaration or your consignment will be delayed.

claims.statement: The Import reference numbers section lists the 'Notification reference' (the notification's own reference) and the 'Customs document code' C640.
claims.quote:

claims.statement: Each import reference has a secondary 'Copy' button that copies its value, so the section has two Copy buttons.
The Copy buttons are custom JavaScript (type=button with data-copy-text) with no GOV.UK Frontend equivalent; without JavaScript they do nothing, so the values must stand as selectable text.
claims.note: Inferred from a type=button with a data attribute and no form; no test clicked Copy.

claims.statement: A submitted notification that needs action ends with a 'Continue' button, a link to the notification hub; a plain submitted or past notification has no button at the foot.
The view page's Back link goes to the overall dashboard (the service root), even when the page was opened from the Live animals list.
A draft notification's view page is editable: each card has a 'Change' link to its question page, such as Origin of import to /origin-of-the-import.
claims.note: Two Change links on a commodity card (commodity, number of animals) both go to consignment-details; documents' Change carries ?from=review.

claims.statement: A draft with incomplete sections shows a GOV.UK error summary 'There is a problem' listing each incomplete section as a link to its card.
claims.quote: There is a problem ... Complete arrival details

claims.statement: The incomplete card in a draft also shows the error inline as a GOV.UK error message under its title.
claims.note: The submitted page's section errors use a custom app-dr2-review-section-error, not govuk-error-message: two styles for one idea.

claims.statement: A draft's view page ends with a 'Continue' submit button in a form that POSTs to /review-notification.

The view page's answer cards, section headings and page header are built from custom app-dr2-review-* classes rather than the GOV.UK summary card and summary list; a govuk-summary-card per card would replace them.

claims.statement: The view page uses only these GOV.UK components: tag, warning text, buttons (primary and secondary), error summary and error message; everything else on it is custom.
claims.quote: govuk-button govuk-button--secondary govuk-grid-column-full govuk-grid-row govuk-tag govuk-visually-hidden govuk-warning-text

claims.statement: Choosing Amend opens a confirmation page at /notifications/amend?reference=<reference>, titled and headed 'Amend this notification?'.
claims.quote: Amend this notification? - Import notification service - GOV.UK

claims.statement: The amend confirmation page shows a GOV.UK summary list of 'Reference number', 'Commodity', 'Number' and 'Origin'.
The confirmation summary shows the commodity as name with species in brackets, re-cased to title case.
claims.note: mechanism: the review shows species 'Bison bison' and the confirm page 'Bison Bison'; the delete page likewise turns 'Ovis aries' into 'Ovis Aries'.

claims.statement: The confirmation summary's 'Number' is the total number of animals across all commodity lines.
claims.note: Inferred: the notification has 1 sheep and 2 goats, and the delete page shows Number 3.

claims.statement: The amend confirmation page asks the trader to confirm in body text under the summary.
claims.quote: Confirm that you want to amend this notification.

claims.statement: The amend confirmation page has a 'Yes, amend' primary button that POSTs the form, and a 'No, cancel' link back to the notification's view page, in a button group.
claims.quote: No, cancel

claims.statement: The amend confirmation page's Back link goes to the notification's view page.
Choosing 'No, cancel' returns to the view page with the notification still Submitted.
The amend confirmation is a server-rendered page using only GOV.UK components (heading, summary list, body, button, link).
'Yes, amend' starts an amendment and opens the amend review at /review-notification (no reference in the URL).
The amend review is headed and titled 'Review your notification' until an answer is changed.
claims.quote: Review your notification - Import notification service - GOV.UK

claims.statement: Once an answer has been changed in the amendment, the amend review's heading and title become 'Review before re-submitting'.
claims.quote: Review before re-submitting - Import notification service - GOV.UK || Review before re-submitting

claims.quote: Amend GBN-AG-26-7K8M2U
claims.note: Seen on the amend review, Origin of the import and Arrival details; not on the declaration or the submitted page.

claims.statement: The amend review shows the answers with Change links on every card, as a draft does.
The amend review has no Import reference numbers section, no Actions menu and no date line.

claims.statement: The amend review's Back link goes to the notification hub.

Are you sure you want to cancel this amendment?

claims.statement: The cancel-amend modal is custom JavaScript (app-dr2-amend-modal, role=dialog, hidden until opened, with an overlay and a Close button); the Cancel amend buttons are type=button and do nothing without JavaScript.

claims.note: No GOV.UK component gives a modal; a confirmation page (like the amend and delete confirmations) would replace it.

claims.statement: 'Yes, cancel amendment' is a GET link to /notifications/cancel-amend, which ends the amendment and redirects to the notification's view page, still Submitted.

A question page opened from the amend review offers three actions: 'Save and return' (primary, back to the review), 'Save and continue' (secondary) and 'Save and return to overview' (a link-styled button).
claims.quote: action=review=Save and return=govuk-button ; action=continue=Save and continue=govuk-button govuk-button--secondary ; action=hub=Save and return to overview=govuk-link app-govuk-body-link

claims.statement: The same three amend actions show on the Arrival details page when it is opened directly during an amendment.
claims.quote: Save and return / Save and continue / Save and return to overview

claims.statement: During an amendment, question pages are pre-filled with the notification's submitted answers.
Saving a changed answer with Save and return brings the trader back to the amend review showing the new value.
The Back link on a question page opened from the amend review does not go back to the review: on Origin of the import it goes to /notification-type, and on Arrival details to the notification hub.

Continue on the amend review is refused silently while the seeded arrival date and port of entry are not in the formats the arrival page saves: the review re-renders with no error summary and no error messages.
claims.note: The test calls this a seed-format quirk. A refused Continue with no message is a defect to keep out of the rebuild.

claims.statement: Once the arrival date and port are re-entered on Arrival details, Continue on the amend review goes on to the declaration.
During an amendment the port of entry is picked from a search that offers options such as 'London Heathrow - LHR', and shows 'Selected London Heathrow - LHR' once chosen.
claims.note: The search uses custom button.app-country-search__option options; the Arrival details page itself is another part's.

claims.statement: The amended port shows on the review in a different form from the search option: the review shows 'London Heathrow', the option 'London Heathrow - LHR'.
claims.note: mechanism: the review shows the seeded port as 'London Heathrow' while the search saves 'London Heathrow - LHR'; the review after the re-pick was not snapshotted for the port.

The delete success banner is set to dismiss itself after 5 seconds, a custom data-auto-dismiss-ms behaviour outside GOV.UK Frontend.

claims.statement: The delete action is offered on submitted notifications, and on the amend review, with no rule seen about which statuses may be deleted.

claims.statement: The network log of every trace in this part shows only the prototype's own server-rendered routes; no outbound call to another system is seen for view, amend, copy or delete.
